Panel: /admin`; await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:txt})
owner: await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:`👑 Owner: 09163017424\n🤖 Bot: VIRUS-MD\n📞 wa.me/2349163017424`})
uptime: let up=process.uptime(); let h=Math.floor(up/3600); let m=Math.floor((up%3600)/60); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:`⏰ Uptime: ${h}h ${m}m`})
link: if(!from.includes('@g.us')) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Group only'}); let code=await sock.groupInviteCode(from); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:`https://chat.whatsapp.com/${code}`})
tagall: if(!from.includes('@g.us')) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Group only'}); let md=await sock.groupMetadata(from); let t='*VIRUS-MD TAGALL*\n'; let mm=[]; for(let p of md.participants){t+=`@${p.id.split('@')[0]} `; mm.push(p.id)}; await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:t,mentions:mm})
hidetag: if(!from.includes('@g.us')) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Group only'}); let text=(msg.message.conversation||msg.message.extendedTextMessage?.text||'').slice(8).trim()||'VIRUS-MD'; let gm=await sock.groupMetadata(from); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:text,mentions:gm.participants.map(a=>a.id)})
kick: if(!from.includes('@g.us')) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Group only'}); let users=msg.message.extendedTextMessage?.contextInfo?.mentionedJid||[]; if(!users[0]) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Tag user: .kick @user'}); await sock.groupParticipantsUpdate(from,users,'remove'); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'✅ Kicked'})
add: if(!from.includes('@g.us')) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Group only'}); let num=(msg.message.conversation||'').split(' ')[1]; if(!num) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Use: .add 2349163017'}); await sock.groupParticipantsUpdate(from,[num+'@s.whatsapp.net'],'add'); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'✅ Added'})
promote: if(!from.includes('@g.us')) return; let u=msg.message.extendedTextMessage?.contextInfo?.mentionedJid||[]; if(!u[0]) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'.promote @user'}); await sock.groupParticipantsUpdate(from,u,'promote'); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'✅ Promoted'})
demote: if(!from.includes('@g.us')) return; let uu=msg.message.extendedTextMessage?.contextInfo?.mentionedJid||[]; if(!uu[0]) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'.demote @user'}); await sock.groupParticipantsUpdate(from,uu,'demote'); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'✅ Demoted'})
poll: let args=(msg.message.conversation||msg.message.extendedTextMessage?.text||'').slice(5).trim(); if(!args.includes('|')) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Use: .poll Question | Option1 | Option2 | Option3'}); let p=args.split('|').map(x=>x.trim()); await sock.sendMessage(from,{poll:{name:p[0],values:p.slice(1),selectableCount:1}})
gcstatus: if(!from.includes('@g.us')) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Group only'}); let t=(msg.message.conversation||msg.message.extendedTextMessage?.text||'').slice(9).trim(); if(!t) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Use: .gcstatus My new description'}); try{await sock.groupUpdateDescription(from,t); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'✅ GC Status/Desc updated'})}catch{await sock.groupUpdateSubject(from,t); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'✅ GC Subject updated'})}
open: if(!from.includes('@g.us')) return; await sock.groupSettingUpdate(from,'not_announcement'); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'✅ Group opened'})
close: if(!from.includes('@g.us')) return; await sock.groupSettingUpdate(from,'announcement'); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'✅ Group closed'})
sticker: let q=msg.message.extendedTextMessage?.contextInfo?.quotedMessage?.imageMessage||msg.message.imageMessage; if(!q) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Reply image with .sticker'}); await sock.sendMessage(from,{sticker:{url:q.url||''}}).catch(async()=>{await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Send image again, processing...' })})
play: let qq=(msg.message.conversation||'').slice(5).trim(); if(!qq) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Use: .play Alan Walker faded'}); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:`🎵 Searching: ${qq}\nUse YouTube link for now, audio feature coming`})
quote: let quotes=['Life na virus, we dey live am','No gree for anybody','VIRUS-MD dey active']; await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:quotes[Math.floor(Math.random()*quotes.length)]})
joke: await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'😂 Why e no dey crash? Because na VIRUS-MD!'})
weather: let city=(msg.message.conversation||'').slice(8).trim()||'Lagos'; await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:`🌤️ Weather for ${city}: Sunny 32°C (demo, connect API later)`})
mode: let mode=(msg.message.conversation||'').split(' ')[1]; if(!mode) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'Use .mode public/private'}); let s=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('./data/settings.json')); s.mode=mode; require('fs').writeFileSync('./data/settings.json',JSON.stringify(s,null,2)); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:`Mode: ${mode}`})
ban: let bn=(msg.message.conversation||'').split(' ')[1]; if(!bn) return sock.sendMessage(from,{text:'.ban 234...'}); let bl=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('./data/banned.json')); if(!bl.includes(bn)) bl.push(bn); require('fs').writeFileSync('./data/banned.json',JSON.stringify(bl)); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:`Banned ${bn}`})
unban: let ub=(msg.message.conversation||'').split(' ')[1]; let bll=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('./data/banned.json')); let nb=bll.filter(x=>x!==ub); require('fs').writeFileSync('./data/banned.json',JSON.stringify(nb)); await sock.sendMessage(from,{text:`Unbanned ${ub}`})
